value.signature: fn install_generation (& mut self , input : & 'a Generation , budget : ReadBudget , usage : & mut Usage) -> Result < bool , Error >

review.body: { let operation = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "storage::tree::MemoryTree < 'a >::install_generation" , & (input , budget) ,) ; let mut meter = Meter { limit : budget , used : Usage :: default () , } ; let result = self . install (input , & mut meter , & mut | _ | Ok (())) ; * usage = meter . used ; operation . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: Public caller-owned admitted carriers and explicit unstable generation declarations, labelled judgements, references and immutable debit origins. Carrier construction and observation are outside the writer allowance. Only stored-state visits and requested reconstruction buffers are charged. No secret input, server session, second law, reader, audit or public publication is enabled.
